title: ExamFile
description: One exam fight of the story (design doc 7.6, 8.9): segments of questions the operator answers while the paper throws a barrage. A Trigger with event exam and this id opens the forecast; the fight then runs in the room and the score goes through core/exam/scoring.ts. Rules the schema cannot state (enemy categories, telegraph lengths, the gap between waves) are checked in core/exam/fight.ts. Text lives in content/strings under exam.<id>.*.

id.description: What an exam Trigger's eventId names; also the prefix of its strings.

paper.description: Enemy id of the exam paper: an immune enemy that stands in the room as a Spawn and throws the barrage. Hitting it answers nothing.

caseEnemy.description: Enemy id of a test case (皜祈?): defeatable, archetype testcase, closed by one hit.

bonusEnemy.description: Enemy id of the bonus question: like a test case, faster and gone after a few seconds.

cloakSeconds.description: Longest the caffeine cloak lasts in the fight, whatever the residue (design doc 8.9: 60).

hitsForZero.description: Hits taken in one segment at which the hit part of the performance reaches 0; fewer hits score in proportion.

gapSeconds.description: Pause between two questions, with no barrage.

afterDialogue.description: Conversation that opens once the result panel is closed.

notes.description: Provenance of the numbers (DOC, ASSUME), as in content/params.json.

ExamBars.description: Readiness bars in percent. A segment's bar is its tag, never below the floor (design doc 7.6: 50%). The base score is 60 at passAt and grows in proportion, times the S of the exam morning.

ExamAdenosine.description: Adenosine in the exam room (design doc 8.9): perDebtHour per hour of sleep debt, at most max; three clinging stacks fail the question being answered.

ExamSegment.description: One sitting: oj is the computer test (moving test cases hit with stationery), proof the written test (proof steps stamped in order with the interact key).

readinessTag.description: Number tag holding this segment's readiness in percent: practice for oj, sleep-archived memory for proof (design doc 7.6).

ExamQuestion.description: An oj question names cases and speedTiles; a proof question names steps.

cases.description: oj: test cases on the floor at once.

speedTiles.description: oj: how fast the test cases drift, in tiles per second.

steps.description: proof: steps to stamp in order; their text is exam.<id>.<question>.step.<n>.

ExamBarrage.description: The paper's distraction barrage: every everySeconds a tier-1 telegraph, then a fan of shots aimed at the operator.

ExamBonus.description: The bonus question (??憿?: one fast case that appears atSeconds into the stage's first question and is gone after seconds.
